Hi Samir / Jenna,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: You want to validate a Redwood-hosted integration for your internal compliance chatbot (PII redaction + recent-doc retrieval). Primary questions were around data residency, rate limits, and how fast you can get a working proof-of-concept.
- Recommendation: Start with a 2-week hosted API evaluation to validate functionality and latency expectations. Hosted lets you move fastest (no infra), and we can parallelize a Dedicated/Dedicated+VPC discussion if you hit policy blockers.

Immediate next steps I suggest:
1) I’ll send a trial API key + quickstart steps (below) — goal: first query within 24 hours.
2) Dev will share recommended endpoints, example curl, and suggested rate-limit/concurrency settings for an evaluation load.
3) You confirm any critical security/residency constraints (e.g., data leave the region? retention?) — we can flag if you need Private VPC.
4) If hosted looks good, we’ll propose a short Mutual Action Plan for a Dedicated capacity pilot.

Quickstart links (hosted):
- Hosted quickstart: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/hosted-api
- Example endpoints & rate limits: attached (hosted-api-endpoints.md)

Attachments: redwood-quickstart.pdf (one-pager), hosted-api-endpoints.md (endpoints + rate limits).

Proposed times for a 30-min quickstart pairing session this week: Wed 2/11 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 2/12 09:00–11:00 PT. What works?

Thanks — happy to jump on the call to unblock setup.

Best,

2) Rate limits/costs: We expect to run ~100 concurrent users for the pilot (roughly 1k QPS at peak). What are the per-minute / per-token limits for the hosted tier? Rough cost ballpark is helpful here so we can model usage.

Hi Samir / Jenna — quick technical notes to answer your questions below.

1) Data residency: For Redwood-hosted evaluations we can provision your trial in a US region (us-west-2) and set retention to minimal (30 days or less) for the evaluation. We do not share data across regions for that tenant. If you need longer retention controls or customer-managed keys, that would push towards Private/VPC.

2) Rate limits & suggested config for evaluation:
- Default hosted soft limit: 1200 requests/min per API key (burstable).
- Token-rate guidance: 60k tokens/min per API key as a practical starting point.
- For ~1k QPS peak, we recommend an initial concurrency pattern using 10 API keys (rotated) + client-side throttling; we can temporarily raise limits for the two-week trial if you want us to.

3) Endpoints & examples (attached): hosted-api-endpoints.md — includes example curl, recommended headers, and a snippet for streaming. Example quick curl: 

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TRIAL_KEY>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","input":"What is the summary of invoice 123?"}'

Notes:
- Use our streaming endpoint for UX-sensitive flows to reduce perceived latency.
- For cost: we bill tokens; I’ll include a rough estimate after you share expected token lengths.

Attachments: hosted-api-endpoints.md (contains endpoint URLs, default rate-limits table, and streaming example).

Happy to do a live pairing session to help get keys installed. If you want higher test limits, tell us target QPS and we’ll provision a temporary raise.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
